romanized_text:
himalay ki talahati men ek chota-sa ganv tha. vahan ke log kheti aur pashupalan para nirbhar the. kai mahinon se varsh nahin hui thi, isalie sabhi kisan chintit the.

ganv ki sabase bujaurg mahil, kamal dadi, roja subah mandir ke pas baithakar bachchon ko prakriti ke mahatv ke bare men kahaniyan sunati thin. unak manan tha ki manushy ko paryavaran ke sath santulan banakar rahan chahie.

ek din bachchon ne milakar ganv ke asapas ke sukhe kshetron men paudhe lagane k nirnay liya. unhonne skul ke shikshakon aur graminon ki madad se saikadaon paudhe lagae. kam kathin tha, lekin sabhi ne utsah ke sath bhag liya.

kuch saptah bad mausam badalane lag. badal ghir ae aur dhire-dhire varsh shuru hui. kheton men hariyali laut ai aur logon ke chehare khil uthe. kisanon ne rahat ki sans li.

kamal dadi ne bachchon se kaha ki varsh keval bhagy k parinam nahin hai; prakriti ki dekhabhal karan bhi utan hi avashyak hai. bachchon ne us din ek mahatvapurn sabak sikh.

neutral_script.dialogue:
Kamal Dadi: "Bachcho, jab hum mandir ke paas baithte hain, toh humein prakriti ki shanti mehsoos hoti hai. Yeh mandir bhi ek prakritik samvedna ka pratik hai."

Kamal Dadi: "Yahaan ki har patta, har paani ka boond, aur har panchhi ki chidiya, sab ek saath milkar ek samvedansheel paristithik tantra banate hain. Agar hum is balance ko todte hain, toh sab kuch khatre mein pad sakta hai."

Kamal Dadi: "Isliye, humein apne jeevan mein prakriti ka samman karna chahiye. Paudhe lagana, paani bachana, aur har chhoti cheez ko samajhna, yeh sab hamare liye aur hamare aane wale peedhiyon ke liye zaroori hai."
